fields.Name: Feature Pipeline Version Steward
fields.Description: Completes Feature Pipeline version changes without a person: for every Active Infer Record Process it runs the golden-set test of a gated pipeline's unevaluated version (once per version and golden-set content) and the one on-demand backfill of a changed version, recording each decision in the run's Details.Outcomes. A pipeline opts out per step with DataFeatureSpec.Unattended.AutoEvaluate / AutoBackfill = false. Optional Configuration: { "RecordProcessIDs": ["<id>"] }.
